contracts.finding: For Simple delivery, select referenceArrayProxy.Take(UseMaxProjectilesCount ? context[MaxProjectilesCountRank] : referenceArrayProxy.Length), deliver each projectile and apply its payload. Ordinary rays roll independently when no existing context attack roll is supplied. MagicHack can replace the array with a selected single projectile.
NeedLoS is true only when the actual ability blueprint lacks ILineOfSightIgnore. AbilityEffectStickyTouch implements that interface.

Native getter base value is transformed by settings, then the enclosing property/rank/stat layers. Apply is actor-free: progression, optional negation, lower then upper cap. Invalid arithmetic can throw and remains fallback.

Spellstrike and Spell Combat are separate native mechanics. The source spell queues native touch delivery. A matching held Magus touch with Spellstrike active can require a UnitAttack rather than a UnitUseAbility. A ranged touch ray does not leave a normal melee touch charge.
